"About the job\nEn Viva buscamos personas apasionadas por lo que hacen y comprometidas con generar un impacto positivo. Estamos convencidos de que este es un gran momento para integrarte a nuestro equipo.\n\nViva es la aerolínea de ultra bajo costo preferida en las Américas, con la flota más joven de Latinoamérica y uno de los mayores ritmos de crecimiento a nivel mundial. Nos distingue una cultura basada en la inclusión, la innovación, la transparencia y la excelencia operativa, siempre con el compromiso de brindar un servicio excepcional y mantener los más altos estándares de seguridad.\n\nÚnete al #TeamViva y forma parte de una organización que impulsa el crecimiento, el desarrollo y la innovación.\n\nSe parte de nuestro equipo como Brand Keeper, donde serás responsable de salvaguardar la identidad, personalidad y consistencia de la marca Viva en todos sus puntos de contacto, asegurando que las campañas, contenidos, materiales y experiencias estén alineados con el Brand Book. Esta posición actúa como guardián de la marca trabajando de manera transversal con áreas internas y agencias externas, participando tanto en la supervisión de la identidad como en la creación y ejecución de materiales gráficos, audiovisuales y proyectos especiales de producción.\n\nFunciones Principales\n\n Brand Governance (Guardián de la marca): Garantizar la correcta aplicación y evolución del Brand Book en todas las piezas, resolviendo dudas de stakeholders y manteniendo actualizados los recursos y assets de marca.\n Brand Consistency: Asegurar una identidad visual y verbal uniforme en todos los canales y puntos de contacto de Viva mediante el trabajo transversal con distintas áreas operativas y comerciales.\n Campañas y proyectos de Marketing: Integrar la esencia de la marca desde las fases iniciales de campaña, colaborando con equipos internos y agencias externas para brindar feedback creativo y validar adaptaciones.\n Diseño y soporte creativo: Desarrollar y ajustar materiales gráficos para formatos digitales, impresos y OOH, apoyando en la creación de conceptos visuales y resolviendo urgencias de diseño.\n Producción audiovisual y fotografía: Coordinar la planeación y ejecución de shootings y piezas en video junto a proveedores y productoras, asegurando la calidad técnica y la organización del banco de assets.\n Trabajo transversal y colaboración estratégica: Facilitar la comunicación fluida entre marketing, comercial, operaciones, agencias y proveedores, actuando como el punto de referencia central para resolver necesidades creativas.\n\nConocimientos o Habilidades Requeridas\n\n Dominio de herramientas de diseño: Manejo avanzado (6 a 10 años de experiencia) de Adobe Creative Studio como Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign.\n Producción visual y nuevas tecnologías: Experiencia intermedia (3 a 6 años) en Motion Graphics, edición de video y herramientas como Canva, así como conocimientos (1 a 3 años) en herramientas de IA aplicadas al diseño y generación de contenido.\n Competencias clave: Habilidades de comunicación, organización, orientación al cliente, proactividad, colaboración y adaptabilidad.\n\nBeneficios de formar parte del #TeamViva\n\n Excelente ambiente laboral y una cultura enfocada en el desarrollo de las personas.\n Fondo de ahorro y caja de ahorro.\n 30 días de aguinaldo.\n Programa Staff Travel, con acceso a vuelos de Viva a tarifas preferenciales para ti y hasta 12 familiares o personas cercanas.\n Acceso a MyIDTravel, plataforma con tarifas preferenciales en más de 20 aerolíneas para viajar a destinos alrededor del mundo.\n Seguro de gastos médicos mayores, seguro de vida y asistencia médica familiar en línea 24/7.\n Convenios y descuentos exclusivos con gimnasios, universidades, tiendas departamentales, restaurantes y diversos establecimientos.\n Prestaciones superiores a las establecidas por la ley.\n\nAcerca de Viva\n\nSomos la aerolínea con el costo más bajo en México y una de las compañías aéreas con mayor crecimiento a nivel global. Operamos con una de las flotas más modernas de Latinoamérica y mantenemos un firme compromiso con la innovación, la eficiencia y la experiencia de nuestros clientes.\n\nEn Viva reconocemos el valor de la diversidad y promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, equitativo y respetuoso, donde cada persona puede desarrollarse plenamente. Fomentamos la colaboración, el aprendizaje continuo y el bienestar integral de nuestro equipo.\n\nSúmate a este vuelo y construyamos juntos tu próximo gran destino profesional.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "About the job\nEn Viva buscamos personas apasionadas por lo que hacen y comprometidas con generar un impacto positivo. Estamos convencidos de que este es un gran momento para integrarte a nuestro equipo.\n\nViva es la aerolínea de ultra bajo costo preferida en las Américas, con la flota más joven de Latinoamérica y uno de los mayores ritmos de crecimiento a nivel mundial. Nos distingue una cultura basada en la inclusión, la innovación, la transparencia y la excelencia operativa, siempre con el compromiso de brindar un servicio excepcional y mantener los más altos estándares de seguridad.\n\nÚnete al #TeamViva y forma parte de una organización que impulsa el crecimiento, el desarrollo y la innovación.\n\nSe parte de nuestro equipo como Brand Keeper, donde serás responsable de salvaguardar la identidad, personalidad y consistencia de la marca Viva en todos sus puntos de contacto, asegurando que las campañas, contenidos, materiales y experiencias estén alineados con el Brand Book. Esta posición actúa como guardián de la marca trabajando de manera transversal con áreas internas y agencias externas, participando tanto en la supervisión de la identidad como en la creación y ejecución de materiales gráficos, audiovisuales y proyectos especiales de producción.\n\nFunciones Principales\n\n Brand Governance (Guardián de la marca): Garantizar la correcta aplicación y evolución del Brand Book en todas las piezas, resolviendo dudas de stakeholders y manteniendo actualizados los recursos y assets de marca.\n Brand Consistency: Asegurar una identidad visual y verbal uniforme en todos los canales y puntos de contacto de Viva mediante el trabajo transversal con distintas áreas operativas y comerciales.\n Campañas y proyectos de Marketing: Integrar la esencia de la marca desde las fases iniciales de campaña, colaborando con equipos internos y agencias externas para brindar feedback creativo y validar adaptaciones.\n Diseño y soporte creativo: Desarrollar y ajustar materiales gráficos para formatos digitales, impresos y OOH, apoyando en la creación de conceptos visuales y resolviendo urgencias de diseño.\n Producción audiovisual y fotografía: Coordinar la planeación y ejecución de shootings y piezas en video junto a proveedores y productoras, asegurando la calidad técnica y la organización del banco de assets.\n Trabajo transversal y colaboración estratégica: Facilitar la comunicación fluida entre marketing, comercial, operaciones, agencias y proveedores, actuando como el punto de referencia central para resolver necesidades creativas.\n\nConocimientos o Habilidades Requeridas\n\n Dominio de herramientas de diseño: Manejo avanzado (6 a 10 años de experiencia) de Adobe Creative Studio como Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign.\n Producción visual y nuevas tecnologías: Experiencia intermedia (3 a 6 años) en Motion Graphics, edición de video y herramientas como Canva, así como conocimientos (1 a 3 años) en herramientas de IA aplicadas al diseño y generación de contenido.\n Competencias clave: Habilidades de comunicación, organización, orientación al cliente, proactividad, colaboración y adaptabilidad.\n\nBeneficios de formar parte del #TeamViva\n\n Excelente ambiente laboral y una cultura enfocada en el desarrollo de las personas.\n Fondo de ahorro y caja de ahorro.\n 30 días de aguinaldo.\n Programa Staff Travel, con acceso a vuelos de Viva a tarifas preferenciales para ti y hasta 12 familiares o personas cercanas.\n Acceso a MyIDTravel, plataforma con tarifas preferenciales en más de 20 aerolíneas para viajar a destinos alrededor del mundo.\n Seguro de gastos médicos mayores, seguro de vida y asistencia médica familiar en línea 24/7.\n Convenios y descuentos exclusivos con gimnasios, universidades, tiendas departamentales, restaurantes y diversos establecimientos.\n Prestaciones superiores a las establecidas por la ley.\n\nAcerca de Viva\n\nSomos la aerolínea con el costo más bajo en México y una de las compañías aéreas con mayor crecimiento a nivel global. Operamos con una de las flotas más modernas de Latinoamérica y mantenemos un firme compromiso con la innovación, la eficiencia y la experiencia de nuestros clientes.\n\nEn Viva reconocemos el valor de la diversidad y promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, equitativo y respetuoso, donde cada persona puede desarrollarse plenamente. Fomentamos la colaboración, el aprendizaje continuo y el bienestar integral de nuestro equipo.\n\nSúmate a este vuelo y construyamos juntos tu próximo gran destino profesional.", "href": null}]}, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "Job Description", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "At Tiffany & Co., joy is central to everything we do, from crafting our exceptional pieces to inspiring clients to express and celebrate the many facets of love. It’s a skill that we’ve been perfecting since 1837, one empowered by our daring vision and entrepreneurial spirit. Together, each generation of employees honor our past while dreaming of our future.The name Tiffany & Co. instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. Since 1837, the masterpieces of Tiffany & Co. have defined style and celebrated the world’s great love stories.The Retail Coach will partner with designated store leaders and retail teams to observe, monitor, and coach teams to ensure Tiffany client experience is delivered consistently, and brand attitudes are demonstrated. Through thoughtful planning of training sessions, partnership with store leadership, on the job coaching and follow up, the Retail Coach will ensure the selling and clienteling skill sets are adopted and demonstrated by the retail teams confidently & skillfully, to meet business needs. The goal is to create Tiffany Brand Ambassadors who are curious and passionate about our clients, the brand, products and have a strategic and optimistic approach to selling and client development.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "At Tiffany & Co., joy is central to everything we do, from crafting our exceptional pieces to inspiring clients to express and celebrate the many facets of love. It’s a skill that we’ve been perfecting since 1837, one empowered by our daring vision and entrepreneurial spirit. Together, each generation of employees honor our past while dreaming of our future.The name Tiffany & Co. instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. Since 1837, the masterpieces of Tiffany & Co. have defined style and celebrated the world’s great love stories.The Retail Coach will partner with designated store leaders and retail teams to observe, monitor, and coach teams to ensure Tiffany client experience is delivered consistently, and brand attitudes are demonstrated. Through thoughtful planning of training sessions, partnership with store leadership, on the job coaching and follow up, the Retail Coach will ensure the selling and clienteling skill sets are adopted and demonstrated by the retail teams confidently & skillfully, to meet business needs. The goal is to create Tiffany Brand Ambassadors who are curious and passionate about our clients, the brand, products and have a strategic and optimistic approach to selling and client development.", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "ResponsibilitiesCoaching for Client Experience", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": true, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "ResponsibilitiesCoaching for Client Experience", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\n•  Align with Retail Goals to implement and drive changes and elevation in Client Experience. \n•  Monitor and observe daily client interactions on the sales floor. Provide feedback to the retail sales team and update Coaching Log as evaluated against Tiffany knowledge, client experience, selling skills and attitude benchmarks/best practices. \n•  Ensure brand behaviors are demonstrated on the sales floors as company standard including but not limited to grooming, image and etiquette, store presentation standards, etc. ", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\n•  Align with Retail Goals to implement and drive changes and elevation in Client Experience. \n•  Monitor and observe daily client interactions on the sales floor. Provide feedback to the retail sales team and update Coaching Log as evaluated against Tiffany knowledge, client experience, selling skills and attitude benchmarks/best practices. \n•  Ensure brand behaviors are demonstrated on the sales floors as company standard including but not limited to grooming, image and etiquette, store presentation standards, etc. ", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "Coaching for Performance", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": true, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "Coaching for Performance", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\n•  Partner with store leaders to identify store opportunities through observation, sales dashboards and NPS.\n    ◦  Create coaching plan for market & store, update coaching log to give visibility on progression & time spent to equipped the sales team. \n    ◦  Monitor and coach the sales team on their client experience behavior, offering short- and long-term solutions to closing performance gaps (coaching, training classes, review of training materials, etc). \n    ◦  Establish frequent check-in schedule with store leadership, market retail performance and learning teams on coaching conversations, progress, and opportunities. \n    ◦  Update training records for employees in Tiffany Oracle Learning Management System (LMS) \n•  Lead by example and help support a culture of coaching & feedback working directly with the Store & Team Managers. ", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\n•  Partner with store leaders to identify store opportunities through observation, sales dashboards and NPS.\n    ◦  Create coaching plan for market & store, update coaching log to give visibility on progression & time spent to equipped the sales team. \n    ◦  Monitor and coach the sales team on their client experience behavior, offering short- and long-term solutions to closing performance gaps (coaching, training classes, review of training materials, etc). \n    ◦  Establish frequent check-in schedule with store leadership, market retail performance and learning teams on coaching conversations, progress, and opportunities. \n    ◦  Update training records for employees in Tiffany Oracle Learning Management System (LMS) \n•  Lead by example and help support a culture of coaching & feedback working directly with the Store & Team Managers. "type": "rich_text", "rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "About the job\nMODATELAS busca Supervisor Distrital Imagen Visual Merchandising en Cuauhtémoc, Ciudad de México\n\n¡Únete a nuestro equipo!\n\nBuscamos un(a)Distrital de Imagen Visualcon experiencia en Visual Merchandising, auditorías y operación en tiendas retail, apasionado(a) por crear experiencias de compra que impulsen las ventas y fortalezcan la identidad de la marca.\n\nObjetivo del puesto\n\nGarantizar la correcta implementación y estandarización de los lineamientos de Imagen Visual en las tiendas asignadas, mediante auditorías, supervisión, capacitación y ejecución de estrategias comerciales.\n\nPrincipales responsabilidades\n\nSupervisar la correcta implementación de los lineamientos de Imagen Visual.\nRealizar auditorías en tiendas y dar seguimiento a planes de acción.\nImplementar montajes, exhibiciones de temporada, cambios de layout y mobiliario.\nCapacitar y asesorar al personal operativo en temas de Visual Merchandising.\nCoordinar actividades con Gerentes de Tienda, Distritales y áreas de apoyo.\nElaborar calendarios de visitas y auditorías.\nAnalizar indicadores y proponer acciones de mejora.\nAdministrar materiales y recursos para proyectos de exhibición.\nElaborar reportes ejecutivos y dar seguimiento a resultados.\nPromover el cumplimiento de políticas y estándares de Imagen Visual.\n\nRequisitos\n\nEscolaridad mínima: Preparatoria concluida, carrera técnica o licenciatura afín.\nExperiencia mínima de 2 años en Visual Merchandising, Imagen Visual o posiciones "type": "rich_text", "rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "About the job\nEn LG Electronics buscamos un In-Store Display Analyst apasionado por la ejecución en punto de venta, visual "text", "text": {"content": "\nThe IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.\n\nWe also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.\n\nWe work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nThe IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.\n\nWe also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.\n\nWe work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nDescripción del empleo", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": true, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nDescripción del empleo", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nBuscamos una persona escaparatista creativa y meticulosa para incorporarse a nuestro dinámico equipo de venta al por menor en Ciudad de México, México. En este puesto, será usted la fuerza creativa que impulse la identidad visual de nuestra tienda, transformando nuestros espacios comerciales en experiencias de marca atractivas que cautiven a los clientes e impulsen las ventas. Trabajará en colaboración con la dirección de la tienda y con equipos multidisciplinares para desarrollar soluciones de exposición innovadoras que pongan de relieve nuestra gama de productos, al tiempo que se mantiene la coherencia de la marca y se maximiza la participación de los clientes. - Diseñar y ejecutar escaparates visualmente atractivos, presentaciones en el interior de la tienda e instalaciones promocionales que se ajusten a las directrices de la marca y a las campañas de temporada\n    ◦ Analizar los datos de ventas, el comportamiento de los clientes y las tendencias del mercado para definir estrategias de merchandising y optimizar la colocación de los productos con el fin de lograr la máxima visibilidad y conversión - Colaborar con las personas responsables de la gestión de la tienda, los equipos de marketing y los departamentos de merchandising para desarrollar e implementar planes de merchandising visual que mejoren la experiencia de compra en su conjunto\n    ◦ Mantener la organización de la distribución de la tienda, asegurándose de que las gamas de productos se presenten de forma lógica y atractiva, al tiempo que se conserva la vitalidad y el atractivo visual del establecimiento. - Gestionar el inventario de materiales de exposición, atrezo y elementos fijos, garantizando un uso eficiente de los recursos y una reposición oportuna. - Supervisar los escaparates de la competencia y las tendencias del sector minorista para identificar oportunidades innovadoras de comercialización y mantener nuestra ventaja competitiva.\n    ◦ Formar y orientar al personal de tienda sobre las mejores prácticas de merchandising visual y las normas de presentación de la marca - Realizar auditorías periódicas de los expositores de las tiendas para garantizar el cumplimiento de las normas de merchandising e identificar áreas de mejora - Trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluidos fines de semana y días festivos, para apoyar las campañas de temporada y los eventos promocionales - Comunicarse de forma eficaz con los miembros del equipo y las partes interesadas para garantizar la ejecución fluida de las iniciativas de merchandising", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nBuscamos una persona escaparatista creativa y meticulosa para incorporarse a nuestro dinámico equipo de venta al por menor en Ciudad de México, México. "plain_text": "\nRequisitos", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nRequisitos: - Entre 2 y 3 años de experiencia profesional como escaparatista en un entorno comercial minorista dinámico - Formación en diseño o formación profesional equivalente en escaparatismo, diseño gráfico o un campo relacionado - Gran sensibilidad para el diseño visual, con buen ojo para el color, la composición y el equilibrio estético\n    ◦ Dominio de los programas y herramientas de diseño (se valorará el uso de Adobe Creative Suite) - Excelente dominio del inglés, tanto oral como escrito - Capacidad demostrada para analizar métricas de ventas y datos de clientes con el fin de tomar decisiones de merchandising - Sólidas habilidades organizativas y de gestión del tiempo, con capacidad para gestionar varios proyectos simultáneamente\n    ◦ Excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación, con capacidad para colaborar eficazmente entre equipos - Capacidad física para trabajar en un entorno minorista, lo que incluye permanecer de pie durante largos periodos de tiempo, levantar peso y trabajar en altura - Flexibilidad para trabajar en horarios variables, incluyendo por las tardes, los fines de semana y los días festivos, según sea necesario\nRequisitos preferentes:\n    ◦ Dominio bilingüe del español y el inglés - Experiencia con sistemas de gestión minorista o software de punto de venta - Conocimiento de las tendencias actuales del comercio minorista, el comportamiento de los consumidores y la dinámica del mercado - Experiencia con herramientas de diseño o visualización en 3D - Historial demostrado en el desarrollo de estrategias de merchandising que hayan incrementado las ventas o la participación de los clientes - Certificación en merchandising visual "JD": {"id": "HRHl", "type": "rich_text", "rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "About the job\nGLOBAL RETAIL EXPERIENCE & VM MANAGER\nLOCATION: Mexico City\nMISSION\nCreate a distinctive, recognizable and consistent SARELLY retail experience across every retailer and market, with the ambition of building SARELLY into one of the most distinctive beauty brands in physical retail.Translate brand identity, product storytelling and commercial priorities into compelling and scalable physical retail experiences, adapted to different retailers, formats and markets while remaining unmistakably SARELLY.This role acts as the functional expert in Retail Experience & Visual Merchandising, developing and codifying the standards, tools and solutions needed to bring the Global GTM retail direction to life.\nABOUT SARELLYSARELLY is a fast-growing, entertainment-native beauty brand born in Mexico, building the next generation of beauty for a global audience.Founded by creator and entrepreneur Anna Sarelly, SARELLY sits at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, community and commerce. We don't just launch products — we create cultural moments around them, combining product innovation, creator-led storytelling and a highly engaged community.Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded from DTC into social commerce, marketplaces and physical retail. Today, the brand is present at leading beauty retailers including Sephora and Ulta in Mexico and is entering its next phase of international growth, including a major U.S. retail expansion.As our physical retail presence grows, we want every SARELLY touchpoint to feel as distinctive, engaging and recognizable as the brand itself — while adapting intelligently to different retailers, formats and markets.We are looking for someone who can translate SARELLY's brand universe and commercial priorities into compelling physical retail experiences, combining strong retail design expertise, visual merchandising sensitivity and flawless execution.\nTEAM & COLLABORATIONS\nReports to: VP Global GTM & Merchandising\nWorks closely with: Creative team, NPD, Market Pods (including local Wholesale teams), with an initial focus on Mexico and the US. \nHighly cross-functional role, collaborating with retail partners and external suppliers to ensure consistent and high-quality retail execution across markets.\nThe VP Global GTM owns the strategic direction for Retail Experience, while the Global Retail Experience & VM Manager acts as the functional expert, defining standards and driving execution across markets.\nKEY RESPONSIBILITIES\n1. Retail Experience & Visual Merchandising\nDefine and continuously evolve SARELLY's Visual Merchandising standards across retailers and markets\nDefine the principles for how SARELLY franchises, hero products and innovation are expressed and navigated within the physical retail environment\nTranslate brand identity, product storytelling, and commercial priorities into compelling physical retail experiences\nPartner with NPD early in the product development process to anticipate retail implications — including fixtures, planograms, testers, assortment and retailer requirements — and ensure retail feasibility from the start\nDevelop clear VM guidelines and scalable, modular solutions that ensure consistency while adapting to different retailers, formats, footprints and markets\nIdentify and propose new retail experience concepts, formats and innovations that strengthen product discovery, storytelling and brand distinctiveness\n\n2. Fixtures, Displays & Retail Design\nOwn the design, development and adaptation of retail fixtures, displays and merchandising solutions\nPartner with Creative to ensure all retail designs are consistent with SARELLY's brand identity and visual standards, with Creative acting as a key approval checkpoint\nDefine layouts, product placement, capacities, shelf organization, planograms and tester strategy based on assortment, shopper behavior and commercial priorities\nLead fixture development from concept through production, working directly with external suppliers and partners, while balancing creative ambition, cost, production feasibility, durability and scalability\nEnsure hero products, launches and key categories receive the appropriate visibility in-store to support product discovery and sell-through\n\n3. Launches & Retail Activations\nTranslate GTM and launch priorities into the physical retail environment\nDefine and coordinate VM needs for launches, seasonal moments, store openings, and key commercial activations\nManage product rotations and assortment updates, including POS materials, testers, and display updates\n\n4. Retail Project Management & Execution Excellence\nLead the project management of retail initiatives across markets, coordinating timelines, budgets, priorities and deliverables across internal teams, retailers and external suppliers\nCoordinate multiple retail projects and concurrent launches, ensuring correct and timely implementation\nEstablish the standards, tools and audit frameworks needed to monitor retail execution consistently across markets\nConduct priority store visits and retail audits to evaluate execution and identify improvement opportunities, while enabling local teams to monitor execution on an ongoing basis\nFollow up on execution gaps and ensure SARELLY's retail standards are consistently maintained across doors and markets\n\n5. Retail Insights & Optimization\nMonitor beauty, fashion and lifestyle retail environments to identify trends and best practices\nAnalyze retail execution and product performance to identify opportunities to improve product placement, visibility and customer experience\nTranslate retail insights into actionable recommendations for GTM, Wholesale and other relevant teams\nFeed retail learnings and retailer-specific opportunities into the Global GTM market feedback loop to inform future launches, Product Development and retail experience evolution\n\n\nWHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKEWithin 12-24 months: \nSARELLY has built one of the most distinctive and recognizable retail experiences in beauty, consistently expressed across retailers and markets.Fixtures, displays, testers, product placement and in-store storytelling work together to make the brand easy to understand, exciting to discover and commercially effective.SARELLY has established clear global retail standards and scalable design principles, while adapting intelligently to the specific needs of each retailer and market.Retail insights and performance continuously inform how the brand improves product visibility, shopper experience and sell-through, as well as future retail concepts.Most importantly, SARELLY's physical presence becomes a powerful expression of the brand universe — instantly recognizable, culturally distinctive and designed to make people stop, explore and engage.\nIDEAL PROFILE\n4–6 years of experience in Visual Merchandising, Retail Experience, Retail Design, Trade Marketing or related roles\nExperience and strong interest in the beauty industry strongly preferred\nStrong understanding of physical retail environments, fixtures, displays, planograms, POS materials and tester management\nGraphic, spatial and/or industrial design experience strongly preferred, with the ability to develop and communicate fixture and retail concepts; portfolio is a plus\nStrong project management experience, including managing timelines, budgets, multiple stakeholders and concurrent launches across complex projects\nExperience coordinating suppliers, production, installations and retail rollouts\nStrong creative and brand sensitivity, combined with a commercial mindset and understanding of shopper behavior\nProactive and self-starting, able to identify opportunities, originate concepts and bring solutions forward rather than only execute briefs\nHighly organized and comfortable managing multiple retailers, markets, projects and deadlines simultaneously\nStrong cross-functional communication skills and fully bilingual (Spanish/English)\nRequirements added by the job poster\n• 1+ years of work experience with Visual Merchandisin", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "About the job\nGLOBAL RETAIL EXPERIENCE & VM MANAGER\nLOCATION: Mexico City\nMISSION\nCreate a distinctive, recognizable and consistent SARELLY retail experience across every retailer and market, with the ambition of building SARELLY into one of the most distinctive beauty brands in physical retail.Translate brand identity, product storytelling and commercial priorities into compelling and scalable physical retail experiences, adapted to different retailers, formats and markets while remaining unmistakably SARELLY.This role acts as the functional expert in Retail Experience & Visual Merchandising, developing and codifying the standards, tools and solutions needed to bring the Global GTM retail direction to life.\nABOUT SARELLYSARELLY is a fast-growing, entertainment-native beauty brand born in Mexico, building the next generation of beauty for a global audience.Founded by creator and entrepreneur Anna Sarelly, SARELLY sits at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, community and commerce. "https://careers.nike.com/lead-account-marketing-innova-culto-latam/job/R-88499"}, "JD": {"id": "HRHl", "type": "rich_text", "rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team\n\nNIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete* in the world. We look for athletes who can push boundaries, elevate our potential and continue leading us to greatness. The next tastemakers, playmakers, risk takers and glue players. Are you game?\n\nWHO YOU’LL WORK WITH\n\nThis role is within the Nike Retail Marketing Mexico team and reports directly into the Account Marketing Sr Manager. The role collaborates closely with Partner Transformation, Visual Merchandising, Ekin, Sales, Merch and Brand teams to develop retail marketing plans and executions in the marketplace. External partnerships include Retail Parnters, creative agencies, suppliers, and vendors.\n\nAPLA Geo and Latam Retail Marketing: including Partnership Transformation, Visual Merchandising, EKINs and Operations.\nLATAM Brand Marketing: Global Football, Running, Training and Kids.\nSales and SMD´s: including Merchandising, Business, Integration, and Marketplace Supply Chain\nPartner teams: across marketing, retail, planning, merchandising, and e-commerce.\nWHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR\n\nNike is seeking a highly organized and motivated creative individual who is passionate about retail executions with strong brand storytelling. This person is driven and a doer, with a sharp eye for detail, thrives in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment.  They are passionate about sport, retail, and consumer journeys to deliver the best experience through stores. This person embraces challenging conversations with external partners (agencies & retailers) and communicates clearly to a broad and diverse audience.\n\nBachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education, experience in executions at Retail stores launching a campaign, Visual merchandising and planning consumer journey.\n6+ years of retail- marketing and Visual Merchandising execution experience. Mid-large fleet and marketplace partner experience.\nA track record of implementing a test and learn offense, with a consumer first mindset. Shown ability of adapting to change in business needs or direction.\nStrategy and goal-set oriented to ensure the executions at Retail are happening in a premium and consumer centered way.\nWHAT YOU’LL WORK ON\n\nYou’ll be responsible for developing and executing retail elevation strategies for Nike with our partner retail doors. From working with our Sale teams, Brand Marketing team and SMD´s to determine seasonal priorities, elevating Nike stories with our retail partners, scaling proven concepts, to working in partnership with our Visual Merchandising and Partnership Transformation teams, you’ll work cross-functionally to bring the best executions of Nike to life in our Partner doors:\n\nLead and develop retail marketing premium execution for the Mexico marketplace for Sporting goods partners. Aligning strategy to Sport Strategy and Priorities with our Sales and consumer needs.\nAdopt and adapt retail excellence principles at the marketplace to win with seasonal and seasonless initiatives to win at the moment of truth executing Global Sport Brand direction.\nDeliver clear direction to agencies and retail partners to execute and maintain retail marketing and visual merchandising Sport Brand standards with our marketplace partners including, Sporting goods, and Sport Specialty.\nBecome the Sport retail expert on marketplace partners to lead the ideation and creation of consumer-right journey and experiences across diverse partner retail environments.\nBuild a strong relationship with our APLA Geo Retail marketing and Partner Transformation teams to ensure they are delivering the tools and guidance we need to ensure premium executions.\nNIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.\n\nNIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team\n\nNIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete* in the world. We look for athletes who can push boundaries, elevate our potential and continue leading us to greatness. The next tastemakers, playmakers, risk takers and glue players. Are you game?\n\nWHO YOU’LL WORK WITH\n\nThis role is within the Nike Retail Marketing Mexico team and reports directly into the Account Marketing Sr Manager. The role collaborates closely with Partner Transformation, Visual Merchandising, Ekin, Sales, Merch and Brand teams to develop retail marketing plans and executions in the marketplace. External partnerships include Retail Parnters, creative agencies, suppliers, and vendors.\n\nAPLA Geo and Latam Retail Marketing: including Partnership Transformation, Visual Merchandising, EKINs and Operations.\nLATAM Brand Marketing: Global Football, Running, Training and Kids.\nSales and SMD´s: including Merchandising, Business, Integration, and Marketplace Supply Chain\nPartner teams: across marketing, retail, planning, merchandising, and e-commerce.\nWHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR\n\nNike is seeking a highly organized and motivated creative individual who is passionate about retail executions with strong brand storytelling. This person is driven and a doer, with a sharp eye for detail, thrives in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment.  They are passionate about sport, retail, and consumer journeys to deliver the best experience through stores. This person embraces challenging conversations with external partners (agencies & retailers) and communicates clearly to a broad and diverse audience.\n\nBachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education, experience in executions at Retail stores launching a campaign, Visual merchandising and planning consumer journey.\n6+ years of retail- marketing and Visual Merchandising execution experience. Mid-large fleet and marketplace partner experience.\nA track record of implementing a test and learn offense, with a consumer first mindset. Shown ability of adapting to change in business needs or direction.\nStrategy and goal-set oriented to ensure the executions at Retail are happening in a premium and consumer centered way.\nWHAT YOU’LL WORK ON\n\nYou’ll be responsible for developing and executing retail elevation strategies for Nike with our partner retail doors. From working with our Sale teams, Brand Marketing team and SMD´s to determine seasonal priorities, elevating Nike stories with our retail partners, scaling proven concepts, to working in partnership with our Visual Merchandising and Partnership Transformation teams, you’ll work cross-functionally to bring the best executions of Nike to life in our Partner doors:\n\nLead and develop retail marketing premium execution for the Mexico marketplace for Sporting goods partners. Aligning strategy to Sport Strategy and Priorities with our Sales and consumer needs.\nAdopt and adapt retail excellence principles at the marketplace to win with seasonal and seasonless initiatives to win at the moment of truth executing Global Sport Brand direction.\nDeliver clear direction to agencies and retail partners to execute and maintain retail marketing and visual merchandising Sport Brand standards with our marketplace partners including, Sporting goods, and Sport Specialty.\nBecome the Sport retail expert on marketplace partners to lead the ideation and creation of consumer-right journey and experiences across diverse partner retail environments.\nBuild a strong relationship with our APLA Geo Retail marketing and Partner Transformation teams to ensure they are delivering the tools and guidance we need to ensure premium executions.\nNIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.\n\nNIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. {"bold": true, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "POSITION", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nWithin the Visual Merchandising team, the Visual Merchandising Trade Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the visibility and execution of soft visual merchandising, creating a cohesive and engaging brand story across retail spaces. The role is responsible for the planning and implementation of soft merchandising elements for brand campaigns and product launches, ensuring consistent brand messaging and strong visual appeal. The position works closely with Product Marketing, Trade, Sales, and In-Store teams to optimize visual merchandising deployment and ensure excellence in execution across points of sale.\n \n", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nWithin the Visual Merchandising team, the Visual Merchandising Trade Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the visibility and execution of soft visual merchandising, creating a cohesive and engaging brand story across retail spaces. The role is responsible for the planning and implementation of soft merchandising elements for brand campaigns and product launches, ensuring consistent brand messaging and strong visual appeal. The position works closely with Product Marketing, Trade, Sales, and In-Store teams to optimize visual merchandising deployment and ensure excellence in execution across points of sale.\n \n", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nJOB RESPONSIBILITIES", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": true, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nJOB RESPONSIBILITIES", "href": null}, {"type": "text", "text": {"content": "\nVisual Merchandising & Trade Execution * Plan and implement soft merchandising elements for brand campaigns and product launches.* Lead the design, production, and installation of Trade projects, including SPPs, HPPs, retailer decorations, events, Sephora animations, and other activations.* Coordinate Counter Takeovers, including forecasting materials from Central and overseeing local implementation.* Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual excellence across retail spaces.* Ensure compliance with brand standards, safety regulations, and retailer requirements. Cross-functional Coordination * Collaborate with Product Marketing, Trade, Sales, and In-Store teams to optimize VM deployment.* Coordinate with external vendors and suppliers for production and implementation.* Manage photography coordination.* Review OOH color proofs and captions. Store Excellence & Follow-up * Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual merchandising execution.* Provide feedback and identify opportunities for improvement.* Monitor the quality and consistency of implementation across locations. Project Management & Operations * Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and budgets are met.* Prepare reports and follow up on key VM activities.* Manage administrative processes, including POs.* Oversee display warehouse management.* Travel to store locations as required. Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs and ongoing projects.\n", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "\nVisual "text": {"content": "\n• Asegurar el cumplimiento del CVP por formato en cada modular.\n• Optimizar la estrategia de surtido y acomodo sustentada en data e insights.\n• Plasmar correctamente la propuesta de valor en el modular, garantizando la mejor experiencia de compra para la clienta.\n• Asegurar el cumplimiento de nuestros principios operativos modulares para garantizar impulso de nuestras marcas, seguridad en tienda y correcta exhibición de nuestro catálogo.\n• Coordinar proceso de Montaje en layout room y copiado de modulares via Space Planning para nuevas versiones de planogramas.\n• Administrar procesos modulares de las categorías a su cargo asegurando cumplimiento mediante seguimiento y coordinación.\n• Validar modulares con simulación digital previo al montaje físico para reducir retrabajo.\n• Automatizar la generación de reportes de cumplimiento de aperturas, mantenimientos y liberaciones.\n• Identificar y comunicar riesgos y oportunidades en los procesos a través de reportes y análisis de data.\n• Analizar KPIs de desempeño de modulares en tiempo real para detección temprana de desviaciones.\n• Construir dashboards de seguimiento para stakeholders de "text": {"content": "El Puerto de Liverpool es la empresa líder en tiendas departamentales en México. CON MÁS DE 170 AÑOS EN EL MERCADO, nos dedicamos a facilitar la selección de productos y brindarles el mejor servicio a las familias mexicanas, esperando superar las expectativas de calidad, moda, valor y atención dentro de un ambiente agradable.Contamos con cinco unidades de negocio: Tiendas Liverpool, Tiendas Suburbia, Centros Comerciales Galerías, Boutiques y Negocios Financieros, componiendo una empresa sólida, que ofrece a sus colaboradores estabilidad financiera y el orgullo de pertenecer a una EMPRESA 100% MEXICANA.NUESTRA MISIÓN ES SERVIR AL CLIENTE EN TODO LUGAR, TODOS LOS DÍAS, TODA LA VIDA, nuestra visión es ser la mejor opción en servicio, surtido y valor. Nuestros valores nos guían hacia el trabajo en equipo, productividad, innovación e integridad.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": false, "strikethrough": false, "underline": false, "code": false, "color": "default"}, "plain_text": "El Puerto de Liverpool es la empresa líder en tiendas departamentales en México. "Coordinar experiencias de marca y eventos en tiendas Liverpool, asegurando estrategia, calidad, ventas, tráfico y rentabilidad nacional.", "link": null}, "annotations": {"bold": false, "italic": icónicas (como Liverpool Insurgentes y Polanco) durante temporalidades clave (Madres, Navidad, Día del Niño).Gestionar un presupuesto dinámico anual, asignando recursos estratégicamente y resolviendo cualquier eventualidad operativa.Liderar licitaciones y briefs con agencias de eventos para garantizar las propuestas creativas más competitivas y viables.Evaluar y aprobar con ojo estético y estratégico las propuestas visuales y renders de las marcas socias (Levis, cosméticos, tecnología, etc.), asegurando que se integren de forma excepcional al recorrido del cliente.Supervisar los trámites de ingreso y normativas de proveedores externos y promotores (incluyendo RepSE e IMSS) con el apoyo de tu equipo.Colaborar interfuncionalmente con los equipos corporativos de compras, legal, operaciones, recursos humanos y publicidad en tiendas foráneas.Liderar y desarrollar directamente a un equipo bajo tu cargo.Liderar la atención y resolución de incidencias en sitio relativas al from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CACHE_PATH = BASE_DIR / "notion_cache.json"
METRICS_PATH = BASE_DIR / "notion_metrics.json"

def _notion_version() -> str:
    # Leído en cada llamada (no al importar el módulo) para no quedar fijado
    # a un valor stale si NOTION_VERSION se carga vía dotenv después del import.
    return os.environ.get("NOTION_VERSION", "2025-09-03")

# --- rate limiting ------------------------------------------------------------
# Notion API: ~3 req/s. Espaciamos llamadas reales (no cacheadas) a este ritmo.
MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("NOTION_MIN_INTERVAL", "0.35"))

# --- cache ----------------------------------------------------------------------
CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("NOTION_CACHE_TTL", str(60 * 60 * 6)))  # 6h default

# --- retry ----------------------------------------------------------------------
MAX_RETRIES = int(os.environ.get("NOTION_MAX_RETRIES", "3"))
RETRYABLE_STATUSES = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}


# --- logging ----------------------------------------------------------------------

logger = logging.getLogger("vantage.notion_client")
if not logger.handlers:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter(
        "%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s", datefmt="%H:%M:%S"
    ))
    logger.addHandler(handler)
    logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("VANTAGE_LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))


# --- error type (reusa el contrato de resolver_layer_v1) -------------------------

class ResolverError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: str, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.message = message


# --- token --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _get_token() -> str:
    token = os.environ.get("NOTION_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("NOTION_API_KEY")
    if not token:
        raise ResolverError("notion_error", "missing notion api token")
    return token


def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {_get_token()}",
        "Notion-Version": _notion_version(),
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }


# --- metrics ----------------------------------------------------------------------

_metrics: Dict[str, Any] = {
    "requests_total": 0,
    "cache_hits": 0,
    "cache_misses": 0,
    "retries": 0,
    "errors_by_status": {},
}


def _load_metrics() -> None:
    global _metrics
    if METRICS_PATH.exists():
        try:
            _metrics.update(json.loads(METRICS_PATH.read_text()))
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            pass


def _save_metrics() -> None:
    try:
        METRICS_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(_metrics, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.warning("no se pudo guardar metrics: %s", exc)


def get_metrics() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(_metrics)


def reset_metrics() -> None:
    global _metrics
    _metrics = {
        "requests_total": 0,
        "cache_hits": 0,
        "cache_misses": 0,
        "retries": 0,
        "errors_by_status": {},
    }
    _save_metrics()


_load_metrics()


# --- cache ----------------------------------------------------------------------

_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}


def _load_cache() -> None:
    global _cache
    if CACHE_PATH.exists():
        try:
            _cache = json.loads(CACHE_PATH.read_text())
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            _cache = {}


def _save_cache() -> None:
    try:
        CACHE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(_cache, ensure_ascii=False))
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.warning("no se pudo guardar cache: %s", exc)


def _cache_get(key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
    entry = _cache.get(key)
    if entry is None:
        return None
    if time.time() - entry["ts"] > CACHE_TTL_SECONDS:
        return None
    return entry["data"]


def _cache_set(key: str, data: Any) -> None:
    _cache[key] = {"ts": time.time(), "data": data}
    _save_cache()


def clear_cache() -> None:
    global _cache
    _cache = {}
    _save_cache()


_load_cache()


# --- throttle ----------------------------------------------------------------------

_last_request_ts = 0.0


def _throttle() -> None:
    global _last_request_ts
    now = time.time()
    wait = MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS - (now - _last_request_ts)
    if wait > 0:
        time.sleep(wait)
    _last_request_ts = time.time()


# --- core request with retry + cache + logging + metrics --------------------------

def notion_get(path: str, use_cache: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    GET a un path de la API de Notion (ej. '/v1/pages/{id}').
    Aplica cache, throttle, retry con backoff exponencial, logging y metrics.
    401 NUNCA se reintenta -- es error de credenciales, no transitorio.
    """
    import requests

    url = f"https://api.notion.com{path}"
    cache_key = f"GET:{path}"

    if use_cache:
        cached = _cache_get(cache_key)
        if cached is not None:
            _metrics["cache_hits"] += 1
            _save_metrics()
            logger.debug("cache HIT  %s", path)
            return cached
        _metrics["cache_misses"] += 1

    last_exc: Optional[Exception] = None
    for attempt in range(1, MAX_RETRIES + 1):
        _throttle()
        start = time.time()
        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, headers=_headers(), timeout=30)
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            logger.warning("request error (attempt %d/%d) %s: %s", attempt, MAX_RETRIES, path, exc)
            _metrics["retries"] += 1
            _save_metrics()
            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            continue

        elapsed = time.time() - start
        _metrics["requests_total"] += 1

        if resp.status_code == 401:
            logger.error("401 unauthorized  %s  (%.2fs)", path, elapsed)
            _metrics["errors_by_status"]["401"] = _metrics["errors_by_status"].get("401", 0) + 1
            _save_metrics()
            raise ResolverError("notion_error", resp.text)

        if resp.status_code in RETRYABLE_STATUSES and attempt < MAX_RETRIES:
            logger.warning(
                "%d retryable  %s  (%.2fs)  attempt %d/%d",
                resp.status_code, path, elapsed, attempt, MAX_RETRIES,
            )
            _metrics["retries"] += 1
            _metrics["errors_by_status"][str(resp.status_code)] = (
                _metrics["errors_by_status"].get(str(resp.status_code), 0) + 1
            )
            _save_metrics()
            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            continue

        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            logger.error("%d error  %s  (%.2fs)", resp.status_code, path, elapsed)
            _metrics["errors_by_status"][str(resp.status_code)] = (
                _metrics["errors_by_status"].get(str(resp.status_code), 0) + 1
            )
            _save_metrics()
            raise ResolverError("notion_error", resp.text)

        logger.debug("200 OK  %s  (%.2fs)", path, elapsed)
        data = resp.json()
        if use_cache:
            _cache_set(cache_key, data)
        _save_metrics()
        return data

    _save_metrics()
    raise ResolverError("notion_error", f"max retries exceeded for {path}: {last_exc}")


def _notion_post(path: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """POST a un path de la API de Notion con retry y metrics."""
    import requests

def _notion_patch(path: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """PATCH a un path de la API de Notion con retry y metrics."""
    import requests

    url = f"https://api.notion.com{path}"

            _metrics["retries"] += 1

# --- Client namespaces -----------------------------------------------------------

class _DataSources:
    """
    Emula client.data_sources de notion-client 3.x.
    Usa el endpoint nativo de data sources (modelo multi-source de Notion).
    Requiere NOTION_VERSION >= 2025-09-03 en el entorno.
    """

    def query(
        self,
        data_source_id: str,
        start_cursor: Optional[str] = None,
        page_size: int = 100,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": page_size}
        if start_cursor:
            payload["start_cursor"] = start_cursor
        payload.update(kwargs)
        return _notion_post(f"/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query", payload)

    def retrieve(self, data_source_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return notion_get(f"/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}", use_cache=True)


class _Pages:
    """Emula client.pages de notion-client."""

    def retrieve(self, page_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return notion_get(f"/v1/pages/{page_id}", use_cache=False)

    def update(self, page_id: str, properties: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return _notion_patch(f"/v1/pages/{page_id}", {"properties": properties})

    def create(self, parent: Dict[str, Any], properties: Dict[str, Any], **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"parent": parent, "properties": properties}
        payload.update(kwargs)
        return _notion_post("/v1/pages", payload)



class _Databases:
    """Emula client.databases de notion-client."""

    def retrieve(self, database_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return notion_get(f"/v1/databases/{database_id}", use_cache=True)

    def query(
        self,
        database_id: str,
        start_cursor: Optional[str] = None,
        page_size: int = 100,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": page_size}
        if start_cursor:
            payload["start_cursor"] = start_cursor
        payload.update(kwargs)
        return _notion_post(f"/v1/databases/{database_id}/query", payload)


class _BlocksChildren:
    """Emula client.blocks.children de notion-client."""

    def list(
        self,
        block_id: str,
        start_cursor: Optional[str] = None,
        page_size: int = 100,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Lista los bloques hijos de un bloque/página."""
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": page_size}
        if start_cursor:
            payload["start_cursor"] = start_cursor
        payload.update(kwargs)
        return _notion_post(f"/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children", payload)


class _Blocks:
    """Emula client.blocks de notion-client."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.children = _BlocksChildren()


# --- Client ----------------------------------------------------------------------

class Client:
    """
    Drop-in replacement para notion-client 3.x.
    Implementa los namespaces usados por los scripts de Vantage:
      - client.data_sources.query(data_source_id=..., **kwargs)
      - client.pages.update(page_id=..., properties=...)
      - client.pages.retrieve(page_id=...)
      - client.pages.create(parent=..., properties=...)
      - client.databases.retrieve(database_id=...)
      - client.databases.query(database_id=..., **kwargs)
      - client.blocks.children.list(block_id=..., **kwargs)
    """

    def __init__(self, auth: Optional[str] = None, token: Optional[str] = None):
        resolved = auth or token
        if resolved:
            os.environ["NOTION_TOKEN"] = resolved

        self.data_sources = _DataSources()
        self.pages = _Pages()
        self.databases = _Databases()
        self.blocks = _Blocks()

    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return get_metrics()

    def clear_cache(self) -> None:
        clear_cache()

    def reset_metrics(self) -> None:
        reset_metrics()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "metrics":
        print(json.dumps(get_metrics(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "clear-cache":

    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "reset-metrics":
        reset_metrics()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
VANTAGE - Orphan Script Audit
Cruza cada script en Layer_1/scripts/ contra el corpus de referencias conocidas
(Raycast, wrappers, triggers.json, config de MCP/Devin, Figma Sync, Manual/Kernel)
y emite un veredicto REFERENCIADO / HUERFANO por archivo.

No mueve ni borra nada — solo genera el reporte. La decision de archivar a
Archive/Legacy_Scripts/DEPRECATED_* sigue siendo del operador (ver skill
vantage-housekeeping-archive).

Uso:
    python3 orphan_audit.py                  # imprime tabla en consola
    python3 orphan_audit.py --out audit.md    # tambien escribe SCRIPT_AUDIT.md
"""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent  # raiz del repo
SCRIPTS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "Layer_1" / "scripts"

# Fuentes que se consideran corpus de referencia valido.
# Se leen como texto crudo y se busca el nombre del script (basename) dentro.
REFERENCE_SOURCES = [
    BASE_DIR / "Raycast",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_1" / "wrappers",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_4" / "wrappers",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_3" / "wrappers",
    BASE_DIR / "skills" / "triggers.json",
    BASE_DIR / ".vscode" / "mcp.json",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_1" / ".devin" / "config.json",
    BASE_DIR / "Figma Sync" / "code.js",
    BASE_DIR / "Figma Sync" / "package.json",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_1" / "package.json",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_4" / "com.vantage.gitsync.plist",
    BASE_DIR / "main.py",
    BASE_DIR / "web_ui.py",
    BASE_DIR / "Layer_1" / "layer_1_pipeline.sh",
    BASE_DIR / "MANUAL.md",
    BASE_DIR / "Documentación" / "ACTIVE" / "Manual.md",
    BASE_DIR / "Documentación" / "ACTIVE" / "Kernel.md",
]


def build_corpus() -> str:
    """Concatena el contenido de todas las fuentes de referencia (recursivo en dirs)."""
    chunks = []
    for src in REFERENCE_SOURCES:
        if not src.exists():
            continue
        if src.is_dir():
            for f in src.rglob("*"):
                if f.is_file():
                    try:
                        chunks.append(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        else:
            try:
                chunks.append(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
            except Exception:
                pass
    # Tambien cruzar cada script contra los DEMAS scripts (llamadas internas)
    for f in SCRIPTS_DIR.glob("*.py"):
        try:
            chunks.append(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return "\n".join(chunks)


def audit() -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:
    corpus = build_corpus()
    results = []
    scripts = sorted(SCRIPTS_DIR.glob("*.py")) + sorted(SCRIPTS_DIR.glob("*.sh"))
    for script in scripts:
        name = script.name
        # Contar ocurrencias del nombre en el corpus, excluyendo el propio archivo
        own_content = script.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        count = corpus.count(name) - own_content.count(name)
        status = "REFERENCIADO" if count > 0 else "HUERFANO"
        results.append((name, max(count, 0), status))
    return results


def render_markdown(results: list[tuple[str, int, str]]) -> str:
    lines = [
        "# SCRIPT_AUDIT.md — Auditoría de Scripts Huérfanos",
        "",
        "Generado por `orphan_audit.py`. No mueve archivos — solo reporta.",
        "El movimiento a `Archive/Legacy_Scripts/DEPRECATED_*` sigue siendo decisión del operador.",
        "",
        "| Script | Referencias | Veredicto |",
        "|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for name, count, status in results:
        lines.append(f"| {name} | {count} | {status} |")
    huerfanos = [r for r in results if r[2] == "HUERFANO"]
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"**Total huérfanos detectados: {len(huerfanos)}**")
    if huerfanos:
        lines.append("")
        for name, _, _ in huerfanos:
            lines.append(f"- {name}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="Ruta de salida para SCRIPT_AUDIT.md (opcional)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    results = audit()
    md = render_markdown(results)
    print(md)

    if args.out:
        Path(args.out).write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"\n[+] Reporte escrito en {args.out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
JHS Pipeline Recovery - Manejo de fallos y resume operations
"""

import os
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from notion_utils import Client

def save_checkpoint(step, data):
    """Save pipeline checkpoint"""
    checkpoint = {
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        "step": step,
        "data": data
    }
    
    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("out/pipeline_checkpoint.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(checkpoint, f, indent=2)

def load_checkpoint():
    """Load last pipeline checkpoint"""
    try:
        with open("out/pipeline_checkpoint.json", "r") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except:
        return None

def clear_checkpoint():
    """Clear checkpoint after successful completion"""
    try:
        os.remove("out/pipeline_checkpoint.json")
    except:
        pass

def safe_execute_step(step_name, step_function, *args, **kwargs):
    """Execute a step with error handling and checkpointing"""
    print(f"🔄 Ejecutando: {step_name}...")
    
    try:
        result = step_function(*args, **kwargs)
        save_checkpoint(step_name, {"status": "completed", "result": result})
        print(f"✅ {step_name} completado")
        return result
    except Exception as e:
        error_data = {"status": "failed", "error": str(e), "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()}
        save_checkpoint(step_name, error_data)
        print(f"❌ {step_name} falló: {e}")
        raise

def resume_pipeline():
    """Resume pipeline from last checkpoint"""
    checkpoint = load_checkpoint()
    
    if not checkpoint:
        print("ℹ️  No hay checkpoint previo. Ejecutando pipeline completo.")
        return False
    
    print(f"🔍 Checkpoint encontrado: {checkpoint['step']}")
    print(f"🗓️  Timestamp: {checkpoint['timestamp']}")
    
    if checkpoint['data'].get('status') == 'completed':
        print(f"✅ Último paso completado exitosamente")
        return False  # Continue normal execution
    elif checkpoint['data'].get('status') == 'failed':
        print(f"❌ Pipeline falló en: {checkpoint['step']}")
        print(f"Error: {checkpoint['data'].get('error', 'Unknown')}")
        
        retry = input("¿Reintentar desde el paso fallido? (y/N): ").lower().strip()
        if retry == 'y':
            return checkpoint['step']  # Return step to retry
        else:
            clear_checkpoint()
            return False
    
    return False

def verify_data_consistency():
    """Verify data consistency after pipeline operations"""
    try:
        load_dotenv(dotenv_path=os.path.abspath(".env"), override=True)
        client = Client(auth=os.environ["NOTION_TOKEN"])
        ds_id = "442938be-fc42-828f-b72e-076818d65a5b"
        
        print("🔍 Verificando consistencia de datos...")
        
        items = client.data_sources.query(data_source_id=ds_id)["results"]
        
        issues = []
        
        for item in items:
            props = item["properties"]
            
            # Check for missing critical fields
            if not props.get("Score", {}).get("number"):
                issues.append(f"[{item['id'][:8]}] Sin Score")
            
            if not props.get("VM_Scope", {}).get("select", {}).get("name"):
                issues.append(f"[{item['id'][:8]}] Sin VM_Scope")
                
            if not props.get("Gate_Decision", {}).get("select", {}).get("name"):
                issues.append(f"[{item['id'][:8]}] Sin Gate_Decision")
        
        if issues:
            print(f"⚠️  {len(issues)} problemas de consistencia detectados:")
            for issue in issues[:5]:  # Show first 5
                print(f"  {issue}")
            if len(issues) > 5:
                print(f"  ... y {len(issues)-5} más")
            return False
        else:
            print("✅ Datos consistentes")
            return True
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error verificando consistencia: {e}")
        return False

def main():
    print("🔧 JHS PIPELINE RECOVERY")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    # Check for resume
    resume_step = resume_pipeline()
    
    if resume_step:
        print(f"🔄 Resumiendo desde: {resume_step}")
        # Here you could implement step-specific resume logic
        # For now, we'll just clear and restart
        clear_checkpoint()
        print("🔄 Reiniciando pipeline completo...")
    
    # Verify current data state
    if verify_data_consistency():
        print("✅ Sistema en estado consistente")
    else:
        print("⚠️  Inconsistencias detectadas - ejecutar pipeline recomendado")
    
    # Clear checkpoint on manual verification
    clear_checkpoint()
    print("\n💡 Para pipeline con recovery automático:")
    print("  ~/vantage_pipeline.sh  → LAYER_1/wrappers/layer_1_wrapper.sh")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
priority_logic.py — Lógica de Prioridad (Class A) compartida.

Extraído de backfill_class_a.py para romper el import circular con
layer_1_run.py (backfill_class_a.py importa is_agregador de layer_1_run.py;
layer_1_run.py necesita infer_prioridad de aquí). Ningún módulo del pipeline
debe importar layer_1_run.py ni backfill_class_a.py desde este archivo.

Consumido por:
  - layer_1_run.py   (Fase 3.6 — escritura primaria en el run semanal)
  - backfill_class_a.py (catch-up de registros legacy / huecos)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date


def txt(prop: dict | None) -> str:
    if not prop:
        return ""
    t = prop.get("type")
    if t == "url":
        return prop.get("url") or ""
    if t == "rich_text" and prop.get("rich_text"):
        return "".join(chunk["plain_text"] for chunk in prop["rich_text"])
    if t == "select" and prop.get("select"):
        return prop["select"]["name"]
    if t == "title" and prop.get("title"):
        return "".join(chunk["plain_text"] for chunk in prop["title"])
    return ""


def get_importancia_bucket(score: int) -> str:
    """
    Determina el bucket de Importancia basado en Score.

    Score=40 es BASE SCORE (sin bonificaciones) = "Sin evaluar"
    Score != 40 tiene al menos un bono activado = valor calculado real
    """
    if score == 40:
        return "Base"
    elif score <= 60:
        return "Media"
    elif score <= 80:
        return "Alta"
    elif score <= 100:
        return "Muy Alta"
    else:
        return "Base"  # fallback defensivo


def apply_importancia_matrix(urgencia: str, importancia_bucket: str) -> str:
    """
    Matriz Urgencia x Importancia -> Prioridad final.

             | Base    | Media   | Alta     | Muy Alta
    CRÍTICO  | 4 CRÍTICO| 4 CRÍTICO| 4 CRÍTICO| 4 CRÍTICO
    ALTO     | 2 MEDIO | 3 ALTO  | 4 CRÍTICO| 4 CRÍTICO
    MEDIO    | 1 BAJO  | 2 MEDIO | 3 ALTO   | 4 CRÍTICO
    BAJO     | 1 BAJO  | 1 BAJO  | 2 MEDIO  | 3 ALTO
    """
    matrix = {
        ("CRÍTICO", "Base"):     "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("CRÍTICO", "Media"):    "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("CRÍTICO", "Alta"):     "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("CRÍTICO", "Muy Alta"): "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("ALTO",    "Base"):     "2 MEDIO",
        ("ALTO",    "Media"):    "3 ALTO",
        ("ALTO",    "Alta"):     "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("ALTO",    "Muy Alta"): "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("MEDIO",   "Base"):     "1 BAJO",
        ("MEDIO",   "Media"):    "2 MEDIO",
        ("MEDIO",   "Alta"):     "3 ALTO",
        ("MEDIO",   "Muy Alta"): "4 CRÍTICO",
        ("BAJO",    "Base"):     "1 BAJO",
        ("BAJO",    "Media"):    "1 BAJO",
        ("BAJO",    "Alta"):     "2 MEDIO",
        ("BAJO",    "Muy Alta"): "3 ALTO",
    }
    return matrix.get((urgencia, importancia_bucket), "1 BAJO")  # fallback defensivo


def infer_prioridad(item: dict, today: date) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Infiere Prioridad usando matriz Urgencia x Importancia.

    Pasos:
    1. Calcular Urgencia (deadline + antigüedad + Source_Type)
    2. Calcular Importancia (bucket de Score)
    3. Aplicar matriz Urgencia x Importancia

    Retorna: (valor_prioridad, razón)
    Valores válidos: "1 BAJO", "2 MEDIO", "3 ALTO", "4 CRÍTICO"

    NOTA — sin cambios de lógica respecto al backfill_class_a.py verificado
    en vivo el 2026-08-03. El Criterio 1 (Source_Type en {Inbound,
    Referencia, Networking} -> Urgencia=CRÍTICO sin chequeo de antigüedad)
    se traslada intacto. Pendiente de decisión operador — no tocado en
    este patch.

    FIX 2026-08-13: created_time se lee de item["created_time"] (raíz del objeto Notion)
    en lugar de props["created_time"] (que no existe).
    """
    props = item["properties"]
    jd_text = txt(props.get("JD")).lower()

    deadline_patterns = [
        r"apply by\s+(\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{2,4})",
        r"deadline\s*[:]\s*(\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{2,4})",
        r"fecha\s+límite\s*[:]\s*(\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{2,4})",
        r"deadline\s*:\s*(\d{1,2}[-/]\d{1,2}[-/]\d{2,4})",
    ]

    deadline_near = False
    for pattern in deadline_patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, jd_text)
        if match:
            try:
                date_str = match.group(1)
                parts = re.findall(r"\d+", date_str)
                if len(parts) >= 3:
                    day, month, year = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
                    if year < 100:
                        year += 2000
                    deadline_date = date(year, month, day)
                    days_until = ((getattr(deadline_date, "date", lambda: deadline_date)() - getattr(today, "date", lambda: today)())).days
                    if days_until <= 5:
                        deadline_near = True
                        break
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                continue

    source_type = txt(props.get("Source_Type "))

    if deadline_near or source_type in {"Inbound", "Referencia", "Networking"}:
        urgencia = "CRÍTICO"
        urgencia_reason = "deadline_jd" if deadline_near else f"source_type_{source_type}"
    else:
        created_time = item.get("created_time")
        if created_time:
            try:
                created_date = date.fromisoformat(created_time.replace("Z", "+00:00").split("T")[0])
                days_old = ((getattr(today, "date", lambda: today)() - getattr(created_date, "date", lambda: created_date)())).days
            except (ValueError, AttributeError):
                urgencia = "MEDIO"
                urgencia_reason = "fecha_invalida"
            else:
                if days_old <= 3:
                    urgencia = "ALTO"
                    urgencia_reason = f"creado_{days_old}_dias"
                elif 4 <= days_old <= 14:
                    urgencia = "MEDIO"
                    urgencia_reason = f"creado_{days_old}_dias"
                else:
                    urgencia = "BAJO"
                    urgencia_reason = f"creado_{days_old}_dias"
        else:
            urgencia = "MEDIO"
            urgencia_reason = "sin_fecha_creacion"

    score = props.get("Score", 40)
    if isinstance(score, dict):
        score = score.get("number", 40)
    try:
        score_int = int(score)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        score_int = 40

    importancia_bucket = get_importancia_bucket(score_int)
    prioridad_final = apply_importancia_matrix(urgencia, importancia_bucket)
    prioridad_reason = f"{urgencia_reason}_{importancia_bucket}"

    return prioridad_final, prioridad_reason

"""
JHS Profile Evolution - Manejo de cambios en perfil y configuración del sistema

import os

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Absolute path, independiente del cwd desde donde se invoque el script

        # Create default config

            "profile": {
                "current_role": "VM & Brand Execution Coordinator",
                "current_company": "L'Oréal Luxe México", 
                "experience_level": "Mid-level",

            },

                "pivot_keywords": ["training", "experience", "producer", "account", "project", "commercial", "manager"],
                "score_weights": {
                    "Alto_VM": 8,
                    "Alto_Pivote": 6,
                    "Bajo_VM": 5,
                    "Bajo_Pivote": 3,
                    "default": 2
                }
            },
            "target_companies": {
                "tier_1_luxury": ["LVMH", "Richemont", "Kering", "Hermès", "Chanel"],
                "tier_2_premium": ["Estée Lauder", "Swarovski", "Hugo Boss", "Pandora"],
                "tier_3_scale": ["Nike", "Adidas", "Apple", "Zara", "Liverpool"]
            },
